lines.en: When I move, the ground shivers.

lines.zh: 六格高的身影慢慢压过来。
lines.en: A six-block shadow bears down slowly.

lines.zh: 七星的光在我脊背上游。
lines.en: Seven-star light crawls along my spine.

lines.zh: 我拖着气走，像拖一座山。
lines.en: I drag my ki like a mountain.

lines.zh: 我落在屋脊上，屋脊就塌。
lines.en: I land on a roof; the roof gives way.
Every step leaves a scorch mark.
My afterimage reaches you first.
I pass straight through the clouds.

lines.zh: 气在我背后拉成一条线。
lines.en: Ki trails behind me in a line.
The opponent's too small. I walk slowly.
I sweep past the treetops and they bend.
This whole path is my shadow.
Heaven and earth shrink beneath me.
My ki barrier turns once.
I raise a hand and the clouds part.
The seven stars glow in my chest.
I wait for you to look up.
One breath, and the wind shifts.
A body this size needn't hurry.
The cracks on me are glowing.

lines.zh: 我把手臂举起来，又放下。
lines.en: I lift an arm, then let it fall.
This ground is already mine.

lines.zh: 我听得很远，连山谷都听。
lines.en: I hear far: even into the valleys.
My shadow covers half the plain.

lines.zh: 什么都不做，也是一种威胁。
lines.en: Doing nothing is also a threat.
I'm storing up ki.
Your angle of looking up is just right.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里只有指甲大。
lines.en: To me you're the size of a fingernail.

lines.zh: 你连我一片鳞都比不上。
lines.en: You aren't worth one of my scales.
Dragon balls in your hands are wasted.
I remember the wish you made.
Want to make another?
You stand tall, but far too small.
I look at you as at an insect.

lines.zh: 七颗星的光，在我脊背上游。
lines.en: The light of seven stars crawls along my back.
The mountain behind you won't stop me.
I know that kind of eye.
Go on, raise your weapon.
All seven stars are watching you.
Don't count on toppling me.

lines.zh: 你走过来的路，我一步跨完。
lines.en: I cross your whole path in one step.
How many blows can you take?

lines.zh: 我把你的名字念一遍，忘了。
lines.en: I said your name once. Forgotten.
Still standing. That's mildly interesting.
This wound isn't worth my attention.
You can hurt me. Commendable nerve.

lines.zh: 六格多高，退半步也算拆招。
lines.en: Six blocks tall, and a half step is still a parry.
Ki plugs the wound.
Painful, but you're too light.
The cracks on me are brightening.
That blow earned one glance.
I've flattened mountains with my own body.
How many more of those do you have?

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，我一口吞。
lines.en: Whatever you hold, I swallow whole.

lines.zh: 这点食物，不如一颗星球。
lines.en: That's not food. A planet would be food.
I don't live by mouth; I live by ki.
Give it here. I'll take it as a trinket.
You reach out very carefully.
Don't fear. I'm not hungry yet.

lines.zh: 你喂我，就是要我记住你。
lines.en: Feed me and I'll remember you.

lines.zh: 那么小一块，掉地上都找不着。
lines.en: So small it'd be lost on the ground.
Raise it higher. I can't see it.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你手里的油味。
lines.en: I smell the oil on your hands.
Hitting me is hitting a mountain.
I'm this big. Can you go around?

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我鳞片上，响了。
lines.en: Your shoulder clanged on my scales.
I felt nothing. You moved three blocks.
My ki field threw you off.
Don't press against me. It burns.
This body doesn't give way.
You're standing in my shadow.
The impact echoed a long way.
Bump me again and I take it as a challenge.
The seven stars need no consort.

lines.zh: 这种事在我身上毫无意义。
lines.en: This means nothing for something like me.
Just look up and watch.

lines.zh: 气与气靠近会撕裂山谷。
lines.en: Ki near ki would tear the valley.
What we exchange is power.

lines.zh: 两个巨大的影子叠在一起。
lines.en: Two huge shadows overlap.
A long fissure opens in the ground.
Not breeding. Resonance.
I'm the elder of the two.

lines.zh: 分开时，附近已经没有树了。
lines.en: When we part, no trees remain nearby.
Two fingers are enough to lift it.
This thing crumbled.
I hold it up to my eye.
Too small to hold properly.
This dragon ball is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，你的手就空了。
lines.en: I take it; your hand is empty.
I crush it to see inside.
This weighs the same as dust.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我一概收走。
lines.en: I take everything on the ground.
I toss it back to you.
Found you. Such a small thing.
Standing still saves me trouble.
One glance down and there you are.
Target locked. The ki begins to turn.
You raise the shield with resolve.
I'll start with a ki laser.
This plain offers no cover.
I can count your heartbeats.
The name doesn't matter. The position does.
The mountain behind you blocks retreat.
Ki gathers into a ball in my palm.

lines.zh: 不急着杀，先看你撑多久。
lines.en: No rush to kill. Let's see how long you last.
Your ki can't cover your whole body.

lines.zh: 四面都是我的气，你选一边。
lines.en: Ki on all sides. Pick one.
I hover high and keep watching.

lines.zh: 你的火把在我脚下很小。
lines.en: Your torch looks tiny under me.
You duck into a cave; the mouth is too narrow.
I cross the whole forest in a step.

lines.zh: 气屏障挡住了你所有的箭。
lines.en: My ki barrier stops every arrow.
Your exits shrink inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作很慢，你看得见。
lines.en: My arm rises slowly. You can see it.
Thunder rolls in the clouds. That's me.

lines.zh: 残影拳，分不清哪个是真的。
lines.en: Afterimage fists. You can't tell which is real.
You're running east. I see it.

lines.zh: 我把那边的树都压倒了。
lines.en: I've flattened the trees over there.
You change direction; I turn with you.
I don't need to chase. I wait.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在山谷里回响。
lines.en: Your breathing echoes in the valley.
This block of ground is full of ki.

lines.zh: 我再低一点，就够着你了。
lines.en: A little lower and I can reach you.
All seven stars are searching for you.

lines.zh: 手掌压下来，连土一起拍。
lines.en: My palm comes down and takes the soil with it.
Meteor combo, falling in a chain.
This fist can punch through a mountain.
A ki laser cuts from my fingertips.
Death Ball. Catch.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我爪里像纸，龙珠也一样。
lines.en: Your armor is paper in my claws, and so are Dragon Balls.
I lift you off the ground.
You're pressed half a block into the dirt.
That one was for the dragon balls.
A ki burst detonates behind you.

lines.zh: 你挡住了上面，下面是空的。
lines.en: You blocked high; below is open.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，石子飞得比箭快。
lines.en: I swing my tail; stones fly faster than arrows.
You're flung a long way.

lines.zh: 地面裂开，我顺势砸下去。
lines.en: The ground splits and I hammer down.
I pinch you between two fingers.
Again. I won't stop.
A hole is forced open in the sky.
I come down from the zenith.
The seven stars light first. Then me.

lines.zh: 地上的影子一下子变宽了。
lines.en: The shadow on the ground widens at once.

lines.zh: 我不用从群系里刷出来。
lines.en: I don't spawn out of a biome.

lines.zh: 气先压下来，你才看见我。
lines.en: The ki presses down before you see me.
Every bird in the valley scattered.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音传了十里。
lines.en: My landing carried ten li.
I stand taller than the clouds.

lines.zh: 我把整片原野踩进地里。
lines.en: I press the whole plain into the earth.
This is my form. Remember it.

lines.zh: 远处的人抬头，看见了我。
lines.en: People far off look up and see me.
One long roar and the wind stops.
The dragon balls on the ground are burning hot.

lines.zh: 我一步步走出天的裂口。
lines.en: I step out of the sky's tear, step by step.

lines.zh: 这世界太窄了，放不下我。
lines.en: This world is too narrow for me.
I raise my head and the sunrise dims.

lines.zh: 火焰在我身上烧，像微风。
lines.en: Fire on my hide, like a breeze.

lines.zh: 我落地砸出深坑，气乱了。
lines.en: My landing digs a crater; the ki scatters.

lines.zh: 水没到我胸口，气被压住了。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and pins my ki.
The blast tears open my barrier.
An arrow sticks in a scale gap. Shallow.

lines.zh: 这股法术绕开了我的护体气。
lines.en: This magic bypassed my guard ki.

lines.zh: 我是饿不死的，只是气弱了。
lines.en: I can't starve. The ki just thins.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，散出火星。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horn and throws sparks.
The void tries to swallow me. I'm too big.
